summary: The Lexis+ retrieval log and saved red-flag reports are app-owned records under the shared data directory: they follow --home and the per-kind env vars, and local-data purge lists and deletes them as the history kind without touching downloaded documents. Copying records from the old location publishes without replacing an existing file, so commands that first touch the new location together never lose each other's records.
reason: They hold matter names, file paths, court excerpts, and user-written reasons; keeping them outside the path ladder let separate homes share matter history and let purge report nothing to delete while that data stayed on disk.
